OpenAPI and Swagger UI: a complete working project

Compare the OpenAPI description with the Swagger UI page that displays it.

Open interactive lesson and complete code

What you are building

A student API with a browser-based testing page

Generate an OpenAPI document describing the endpoints. Swagger UI reads it and lets you send requests from a webpage during development.

This example uses an in-memory student store. Documentation is enabled in Development.

Check the result

Run the API in Development, open /swagger and try creating and reading a student.

OpenAPI is a machine-readable map of your API. Swagger UI draws a test page from that map. They are separate tools.

Open and run the complete example

Download the ZIP below and open StudyLab.csproj in Visual Studio. Restore its packages. The project includes Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi for generating the document and Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.SwaggerUI for displaying it.

In Visual Studio’s PowerShell terminal, inside the project folder:

$env:ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT="Development"
dotnet run --urls http://localhost:5100

Open http://localhost:5100/openapi/v1.json to see the document. Open http://localhost:5100/swagger to see the test UI. Expand POST /api/students, choose Try it out, paste {"name":"Lefa","age":22}, then Execute. Expected: 201 Created. Use GET to read it, PUT to edit, DELETE to remove it, then GET again for404.

Read Program.cs

AddOpenApi registers the generator. MapOpenApi exposes the document route. UseSwaggerUI points the viewer at that route. MapControllers maps the actual API operations. This combination does not need AddSwaggerGen. If /swagger gives404, check the environment, installed UI package, port and Program.cs; the built-in .NET10 template alone does not promise a Swagger UI.

Try it yourself

Why should the document and UI routes be restricted in a deployed service?

They can reveal the API surface and permit convenient requests. Expose them only deliberately, with suitable access control. Hiding documentation is not a substitute for securing endpoints.

What should happen when you post an age of2?

The controller’s validation should return400. An attractive UI does not replace server-side validation.

Predict and practise

Are the OpenAPI JSON document and Swagger UI the same thing?

Check your prediction

No. The document describes the API. Swagger UI displays it and provides request controls.

Make one change

Open /swagger in Development and send a GET request.

Worked guidance

The viewer reads /openapi/v1.json. Check both addresses if endpoints are missing.

Try independently

Create and read a student through Swagger UI, then explain the response status.
